column5: Source volume mix ratio A:B is 1:1; its separate weight ratio is 100:90. Properties are measured after seven days at 23 C, not at the ten-minute demold time. Original tensile strength/modulus are 3000/139500 psi, flexural strength/modulus 4510/128000 psi and compression strength/modulus 4000/45800 psi; conversion uses 6894.757293168 Pa/psi. Test rate, moisture and uncertainty are unstated. Casting pressure and any post-cure history used for the table are not identified by the processing recommendations. Molding shrinkage is a process observation, not thermal expansion. These different test moduli do not supply an isotropic elastic law.
